name: Colindres (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Colindres (a tower, a tree and a ship on blue).
history: The flag of Colindres is composed of three horizontal stripes, green, yellow and green from top to bottom; it was chosen by vote among the schoolchildren of the two schools of the town in 1984, and the arms of the town were added to it recently.

features.role: Colindres arms — tower, tree and ship
